name: @getpaseo/plugin-example-cursor-sdk-provider
description: Paseo provider plugin that runs Cursor agents through @cursor/sdk

scripts.login: node --input-type=module -e "const { Cursor } = await import('@cursor/sdk'); const result = await Cursor.auth.login({ apiKeyName: 'Paseo' }); console.log('Signed in to Cursor as', result.email ?? '(unknown)');"
scripts.login:status: node --input-type=module -e "const { Cursor } = await import('@cursor/sdk'); console.log(await Cursor.auth.status());"
